usersPage.title: Users
usersPage.resetSSOLinkConfirm: Reset the SSO link of {{email}}? Their sessions end now, and their next SSO sign-in links the account to whichever identity presents this address, so make sure it is the address the provider sends now.
usersPage.resetDirectoryLinkConfirm: Reset the directory link of {{email}}? Their sessions end now, and their next sign-in or sync binds the account to whichever directory entry presents this address, so make sure it is the address the directory has now.

prefilledActiveDirectory: Pre-filled for Active Directory (sAMAccountName, userPrincipalName, displayName)

authConfig.nameDescription: What this configuration is called in the list.
authConfig.keepCurrent: Leave blank to keep the current one.
authConfig.groupToRoleMappingDescription: Each mapped group gives its members a role.
authConfig.defaultRoleDescription: Given to someone who is in no mapped group.
authConfig.testConnectionDescription: Tries the configuration as it is saved. Edits above are not tested until they are saved.

ldapPage.summaryNone: No directory is configured, so nobody signs in through LDAP.
ldapPage.summary_one: {{count}} directory configured, {{enabled}} enabled. Group membership decides each person's role.
ldapPage.summary_other: {{count}} directories configured, {{enabled}} enabled. Group membership decides each person's role.
ldapPage.emptyDescription: Add a configuration to let people sign in with their OpenLDAP or Active Directory account.
ldapPage.enabledDescription: People can sign in through this directory only while it is on.
ldapPage.serverUrlMoved: This directory is moving to a new address, so it needs the bind password again. The stored one is only ever sent to the address it was saved for.
ldapPage.serverUrlDescription: Starts with ldap:// or ldaps:// and names the port.
ldapPage.startTLSDescription: Upgrade an ldap:// connection to TLS before any password is sent.
ldapPage.skipTLSVerifyDescription: Accept the server's certificate without checking it.
ldapPage.bindDNDescription: The account Nexara searches the directory as.
ldapPage.bindPasswordReenter: Re-enter the bind password for the new address
ldapPage.userSearchDescription: How a person who signs in is found, and which attributes become their account.
ldapPage.userFilterDescription: {{placeholder}} stands for what was typed at sign-in.
ldapPage.groupFilterDescription: {{placeholder}} stands for the DN of the person signing in.
ldapPage.noMappings: No mappings configured. LDAP users will be assigned the default role.
ldapPage.syncIntervalDescription: Minutes between background syncs of this directory. 0 turns them off.
ldapPage.syncNowDescription: Runs a sync of the saved configuration without waiting for the interval.
ldapPage.keptActiveCount_one: {{count}} kept active (you, or the last user manager)
ldapPage.keptActiveCount_other: {{count}} kept active (you, or the last user manager)
ldapPage.deactivateMessage_one: The directory found no entry for {{count}} account, so the sync changed nothing. This usually means the user filter, the search base DN or the bind account's access is wrong. Deactivate them only if these people have left: the accounts named will no longer be able to sign in, and their sessions end. Your own account and the last user manager stay active.
ldapPage.deactivateMessage_other: The directory found no entry for {{count}} accounts, so the sync changed nothing. This usually means the user filter, the search base DN or the bind account's access is wrong. Deactivate them only if these people have left: the accounts named will no longer be able to sign in, and their sessions end. Your own account and the last user manager stay active.
ldapPage.transportMessage: {{message}} This is fine for a self-hosted lab directory — confirm to continue, or go back and use ldaps:// or StartTLS.

configureOIDC: Configure OpenID Connect single sign-on with your identity provider
noOIDCConfigs: No OIDC configurations. Click "Add Config" to set up SSO.
redirectUriHint: Register this URL in your IdP as the redirect/callback URI
autoProvisionHint: Automatically create accounts on first SSO login
deleteOIDCConfirm: Delete this OIDC configuration? SSO users will no longer be able to log in.

oidcPage.summaryNone: No identity provider is configured, so there is no single sign-on.
oidcPage.emptyDescription: Add a configuration to let people sign in through your identity provider.
oidcPage.hintCustom: Enter your OIDC provider details manually
oidcPage.enabledDescription: People can sign in through this provider only while it is on.
oidcPage.linkedAccountsStranded_one: {{count}} account is linked to the current issuer. After the change, each is refused at sign-in until its link is reset.
oidcPage.linkedAccountsStranded_other: {{count}} accounts are linked to the current issuer. After the change, each is refused at sign-in until its link is reset.
oidcPage.issuerMoved: This provider is moving to a new issuer, so it needs the client secret again. The stored one is only ever sent to the address it was saved for.
oidcPage.issuerPrivateConfirmed: Confirmed for a private network address. A new issuer is asked about again.
oidcPage.clientSecretReenter: Re-enter the client secret for the new issuer
oidcPage.claimsDescription: Which claims in the ID token become the account's email, name and groups.
oidcPage.relaxedStepUp: Allow relaxed 2FA confirmation for a provider that cannot report a fresh sign-in
oidcPage.relaxedStepUpDescription: Before 2FA setup, accept a completed sign-in round trip at the provider as the confirmation. This still keeps out someone who has only a stolen session token. It does not keep out someone at the owner's unlocked browser while their provider session is open.
oidcPage.linkedAccountsDescription_one: {{count}} account is bound to an identity of this issuer. After an issuer change, reset every link so that each account links again by its address at its next sign-in.
oidcPage.linkedAccountsDescription_other: {{count}} accounts are bound to an identity of this issuer. After an issuer change, reset every link so that each account links again by its address at its next sign-in.
oidcPage.resetAllLinksConfirm: Reset the SSO link of every SSO account? Every SSO session ends now, yours too if you signed in with SSO, and each account links to whichever identity presents its address at its next sign-in, so make sure the addresses match what the provider sends now.
oidcPage.noMappings: No mappings configured. SSO users will be assigned the default role.
oidcPage.discoveryEndpointDescription: Asks the issuer for its OpenID configuration.
oidcPage.cleartextCallbackMessage: {{message}} This is fine for a self-hosted lab with no TLS — confirm to continue, or go back and use an https callback.
oidcPage.issuerChangeTitle: Accounts are linked to the current issuer
oidcPage.issuerChangeMessage: {{message}} Reset all SSO links after the change to let them sign in again.
